description: REQUIRES prior si4n__session__login call with same account_link_id. Read-only. Returns the premium the workplace owes and what is still unpaid. Pick by_insurance to split the amount across the four insurances, or regular_batch / batch to read the notice as one total. Does not pay anything. Files: a document generated from this result, as Excel (xlsx) only when requested in output_formats, listed in artifacts[] of the result with a download_url that works for 15 minutes; each file is kept for 7 days. If a link has expired, call xdata__job__result with the job_id from the result for fresh links. 호출마다 토큰 1소진

account_link_id.description: Account link ID (UUID v4). Optional — the server auto-resolves from your API key when omitted. Provide explicitly only when you have multiple certificates for the same provider. Each institution has a separate ID (Hometax != NHIS != NPS != FourInsure).

insurance_type.description: Optional. Narrows the by_insurance view to one insurance.

output_formats.description: Optional. Also return this result as a file (Excel (xlsx)) in artifacts[] of the result. Omit it for data only.

view.description: by_insurance splits the four insurances; the others read the notice as one total.
